title: Comparison of the Drinfeld morphism with the categorical Radford isomorphism
difficulty_reason: The categorical Radford δ and Hopf bimodule equivalence are supplied. The new proof constructs a braided isomorphism ι from ρ and Σ, identifies it with the Drinfeld u by comparing two distinct Hom rotations through the canonical algebra, then dualizes and composes ι inside the Hopf bimodule category using (7.59). The resulting expansion must be aligned with the already constructed δ and descended through the fully faithful tensor equivalence. This comparison between two different duality constructions carries the new proof; it is not covered by prior ordinary or categorical Radford claims.
